_doc: Platinum's own overworld graphics ids -> Black 2 object codes, over data/pearl_sprite_map.json (pearl_events.sprite_table: a Platinum build reads both; Pearl and Diamond never read this file). Platinum numbers ids 0-209 as Pearl does (pokeplatinum generated/object_events_gfx.txt against pokediamond sprites.h) and adds 210-275; of 0-209 only the player's sheets, Barry 148, Palmer 169, Buneary 206 and Happiny 207 have new art in Platinum's mmodel.narc, the same people: their rows here keep Pearl's codes and take Platinum's pixels. Step 6 (2026-11-07, plat-sprites) gave every id the installed zones use Platinum's own picture (the user 2026-11-03): people on 12-frame walker codes (patches/pearl_npc_sprites PLATINUM_PEOPLE), 3D and wide objects as Black 2 3D-model actors with Platinum's own models (PLATINUM_MODELS). code = Black 2 object code (b2tools/platinum_events.py checks each against b2_const in pokebw2 generated/obj_codes.txt), null = no actor (the object is left out and listed). step6 = what step 6 still has to bring (null: nothing); stand_in false = the code shows Platinum's own picture. Rows are for the ids the installed zones use (b2tools/platinum_events.py lists any other); the Frontier Brains (215-219) and the Distortion World's ids come with steps 8 and 7.
